base: s02_base = stage-01 xa_trueib_cos_awgn (strict-IB input |f|<=62.5 kHz, CrossAttn embedder without OOB path, 2 HSTU mixers, long_cos, AWGN U[0,50) dB)
notes: Every arm differs from s02_base in exactly one factor (except the CIS rank-16 reference, compared with stage-01 cis_flat). See README.md.

arms.name: s02_base
arms.desc: stage-01 winner re-run (also a determinism check against stage-01 xa_trueib_cos_awgn)

arms.name: s02_meanchirp
arms.desc: replace the packet by its coherent 8-symbol mean chirp (= keep only DFT comb bins k=0 mod 8) before the IB band limit; removes symbol-to-symbol residual/transient

arms.name: s02_combfft
arms.desc: FFT view keeps only comb bins (periodic part); I/Q and amp/phase views unchanged

arms.name: s02_dechirp
arms.desc: after the IB band limit multiply by conj(ideal SF7 upchirp): every view sees the dechirped (tone-like) signal

arms.name: s02_rawoob_full
arms.desc: + paper-1 OOB pathway (ratio |X|/IB-RMS, all |f|>62.5k of the FULL-band packet) as cross-attention keys/values; main tokens stay strict IB

arms.name: s02_rawoob_near
arms.desc: same, OOB keys restricted to 62.5<|f|<=200 kHz

arms.name: s02_rawoob_nearL
arms.desc: same, OOB keys restricted to the left near band -100..-62.5 kHz (stage-00: most transferable OOB information)

arms.name: s02_cisoob
arms.desc: + OOB keys/values = channel-independent spectrogram rows with |f|>62.5 kHz (35 rows x 126 frames, adjacent-frame quotient) of the full-band packet

arms.name: s02_tfsplit
arms.desc: time stream (I/Q, amp/phase) and frequency stream (FFT) with separate positions, on strict-IB input

arms.name: s02_awgn10
arms.desc: AWGN SNR ~ U[10,50) dB instead of U[0,50)

arms.name: s02_cis_rank16
arms.head: rank16
arms.desc: Shen-CIS with the rank-16 head (658,314 params; keeps time-frequency position), official recipe + AWGN: fair lightweight CIS control
